title: Windows evaluation: compare routes on the frozen task, decide, and prove rollback
purpose: The m24-5 and m24-6 command surface for Windows 11 (Cells B and C): run the frozen ten-case ticket-classification set through the local route, compare against your other route with your m13 harness, write the three-way verdict with a pre-written rollback line, and rehearse the rollback. The frozen task fixture is ticket classification (plan 06 amendment 3b-1); the ten cases ship in the course's eval fixture. Numbers you record are bounded observations on your machine and date, never a leaderboard claim. Status is CANARY: authored 2026-07-25 from the verified Cell A record with commands translated to PowerShell, not yet executed on a real Windows machine; it flips to current after a start-to-finish on-OS run.
hardware_class: Cell B or C (either Windows runtime cell)
runtime_version: 0.20.2 (version verified on Cell A; record this cell's at verify)
prerequisites: The Windows runtime and swap recipes completed
The course eval fixture (assets/orchard-mock-runtime/fixtures/eval-cases.json) for the ten frozen inputs and expected fields
Your Module 13 eval harness for scoring and blind pairwise review

steps.purpose: Write the ten-case runner to a file (PowerShell quoting makes long one-liners hostile; a here-string keeps the program readable), then run it with thinking off and temperature zero, saving raw responses. The schema and enums come from the frozen fixture.
steps.command:
@'
import json, time, pathlib, urllib.request
cases = json.load(open('eval-cases.json'))['cases']
sys_p = ('You classify support tickets. Reply with ONLY a JSON object with fields: '
         'reasoning (string), urgency (low|medium|high|critical), '
         'category (billing|bug|feature_request|account|other), '
         'suggested_action (auto_reply|route_to_billing|escalate|human_review), '
         'confidence (0.0 to 1.0).')
out = []
for c in cases:
    p = {'model': 'qwen3.5:2b', 'stream': False, 'think': False, 'format': 'json',
         'options': {'temperature': 0},
         'messages': [{'role': 'system', 'content': sys_p},
                      {'role': 'user', 'content': c['input']}]}
    r = urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/chat', method='POST',
                               data=json.dumps(p).encode(),
                               headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'})
    t = time.monotonic()
    b = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=300))
    out.append({'case_id': c['case_id'], 'seconds': round(time.monotonic() - t, 2),
                'raw': b['message']['content']})
pathlib.Path('local-route-run.json').write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
print('saved', len(out), 'responses')
'@ | Set-Content run_local_eval.py; python run_local_eval.py
steps.expected_output: saved 10 responses, written to local-route-run.json. On Cell A all 10 parsed as valid JSON, first response a few seconds cold then about one second each warm; a CPU cell will be slower per case. Record this cell's parse count and timings at verify.
steps.stop: Ctrl+C; rerun from the top, the run is idempotent.
common_errors: Unable to connect: start the runtime.
Responses containing reasoning prose instead of JSON: confirm think false and format json are in the payload; both matter.

steps.purpose: Run the same ten inputs through your comparison route (hosted, or the mock fallback) with your harness, same prompt, same caps, changing only the route.
steps.expected_output: A second saved run file with the same shape. The exact command is your harness's; what is fixed is the discipline: same inputs, same prompt version, same output cap, route as the only change.
common_errors: Different prompt or caps between routes: the comparison is void; rerun with everything held constant.

steps.purpose: Score both runs: exact-match and schema mechanics against the fixture's expected fields, then blind pairwise review with route names stripped, both directions.
steps.expected_output: Per-route parse rate, category and urgency match counts, failure categories per miss, and a pairwise sheet. Record time-to-first-token and generation observations separately with their dates.
steps.undo: Nothing to undo; scoring reads run files.
common_errors: Grading with route names visible: redo blind; knowing which answer came from which route is a thumb on the scale.

steps.purpose: Write the verdict before touching any config: default, optional route, or rejected, with thresholds and the rollback line decided now.
steps.command:
@'
# Local_Route_Promotion_Decision
verdict: [default | optional-route | rejected]
threshold_used:
failure_categories_observed:
capacity_triggers:
fallback_policy:
rollback_criterion:
jobs_remaining_hosted_and_why:
review_date:
'@ | Set-Content Local_Route_Promotion_Decision.md
steps.expected_output: The decision file skeleton exists; fill every field from the scored evidence. A promotion without a pre-written rollback criterion is a hope with a deploy step.

steps.purpose: Rehearse the rollback for real: restore the previous route by configuration, unload the local model, and rerun the smoke test.
steps.expected_output: The application answers on the restored route, then the model unloads and its memory is released. The route change is one environment variable.
steps.undo: Select the local route again by configuration; the next request reloads the model automatically. Remove-Item Env:CWV_CONNECTION clears the session variable.
common_errors: Quitting the runtime's tray application instead of unloading the model: that stops the service for everything in your session; the drill only needs the model unloaded.

health_check: local-route-run.json holds ten parsed responses and the decision file has no empty rollback_criterion field
expected_result: DESK EXPECTATION pending on-OS verify: two complete run files, a blind-scored comparison with failure categories, a three-way verdict with a pre-written rollback line, and a rehearsed rollback trace. The record states which jobs remain hosted and why.
expected_memory: the loaded model's footprint from the runtime recipe during runs; released by the unload step
validated_context: 4096, inherited from the runtime recipe (Cell A validated; revalidate at verify)
privacy_notes: The ten fixture inputs are course-authored synthetic tickets; nothing sensitive leaves the machine on the local route.
If your comparison route is hosted, the same ten synthetic inputs are what crosses; use nothing else for this drill.
known_failures: Thinking left on or format json omitted breaks parse rates; step 1 pins both.
Comparing runs made with different prompts, caps, or sampling: void, rerun.
Reading the ten-case result as a general model ranking: the claim discipline in m24-5 bounds every sentence to task, machine, and date.
